summary: This note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on Chester Township, one of twenty-four townships in Saunders County, Nebraska, United States. It gives the township's population at the 2000 census and a 2006 estimate. The note contains no further detail beyond these basic facts.
one_line: Chester Township is one of twenty-four townships in Saunders County, Nebraska, with population figures from 2000 and 2006.
key_facts: Chester Township is one of twenty-four townships in Saunders County, Nebraska, United States.
The population of Chester Township was 521 at the 2000 census.
A 2006 estimate placed the population of Chester Township at 511.
